# Copilot instructions

For chemistry plotting or fitting tasks, follow `SKILL.md`.

Prefer `scripts/plot_chem.py` for simple XY plots and
`scripts/plot_advanced.py` for multi-panel/3D/heatmap/contour/bar/pie/box and
nonlinear fits. Only use `scripts/origin_plot.ps1` when a real `.opju` is
required and Origin is activated.

Never produce or return a demo-watermarked Origin figure.
